adjudication.rationale: The new webhook handler authenticates solely via a static shared-secret header and then blindly applies `reqBody.userId` (from the request body) to `prisma.credential.findFirst/update/create`, enabling creation/overwrite of credentials for any existing user ID if the secret is known. However, this is the intended trust model for a webhook endpoint (the secret is the ACL), and the diff even documents generating a strong random secret; the “brute-forcing” framing isn’t supported by the diff. This is still a concrete security/design hardening concern introduced by the change (single secret grants instance-wide write on any userId) rather than a definite functional defect.
